name: Slack
diffReason: Moderate: other workspaces can install without review, but apps outside the Slack Marketplace get lower rate limits on some methods

steps.d: On the Slack apps page, choose Create an app, then Blank app. Give it a name and pick a development workspace.
Add an HTTPS redirect URL with no #, and only the bot scopes you use. PKCE is optional.
In Manage Distribution, complete the checklist and click Activate Public Distribution. Other workspaces can then install it without a review.
Only needed to be listed. The app must be installed on 10 or more active workspaces first.

blockers.s: Since May 29, 2025, new apps outside the Marketplace are limited to 1 request a minute and 15 objects on conversations.history and conversations.replies.
Slack's published estimate: up to 10 business days for the preliminary review, then up to 10 weeks for the functional review of a new submission.

agent: Pick minimum scopes for your use case
you: Create the app in your workspace
sources: Rate limit changes for non-Marketplace apps

checklist.answer: Create the app from the Slack apps page by choosing Create an app, then pick Blank app.
A Slack app lives in one workspace unless you distribute it. You can distribute it unlisted, or list it in the Slack Marketplace after review.
Creating an app needs an App Name and a development workspace.
Redirect URLs must use HTTPS and can't contain an anchor (#). Your redirect_uri must match a configured Redirect URL or be a subdirectory of one.
PKCE is optional. Turning it on marks your app as a public client, and that can't be undone.
Add bot scopes with scope= and user scopes with user_scope=, comma separated.
Unlisted public distribution needs no Slack review. Apps listed in the Slack Marketplace are reviewed against Slack's requirements and guidelines.

“Currently, the preliminary part of the review takes up to 10 business days to receive feedback, while the functional review takes up to 10 weeks for new submissions and 6 weeks for published apps resubmitting changes.”
Since May 29, 2025, new apps outside the Marketplace are limited to 1 request per minute and 15 objects per request on conversations.history and conversations.replies.
Slack returns apps that arrive with bugs, poor user experience or repeated quality problems, and asks you to fix them before you resubmit.
